result.summary: Several visual problems stand out: a popular restaurant card with a missing/broken image placeholder, truncated restaurant names, and a promo banner whose supporting text has weak contrast on the green background.

issues.description: The first card under 'Popular right now' (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) shows only a gray placeholder with a broken-image icon instead of a food photo, while other cards have images.
issues.suggestion: Load the restaurant image correctly or provide a proper fallback illustration so the card matches the rest of the feed.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated with the last letters cut off in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a shorter display name, or ensure horizontal cards give enough width so full names remain readable.

issues.description: Promo banner secondary text ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') is light green on a medium green background and has low contrast.
issues.suggestion: Use white or a much lighter tint for the secondary line so it meets WCAG contrast requirements against the green banner.

issues.description: Category chips row ends with a partially visible empty/white chip on the right, which looks like a stray or unfinished control rather than a clear overflow hint.
issues.suggestion: Ensure only real categories appear in the scroller and that overflow is indicated cleanly without an empty pill fragment.
